run_multilora_offline_inference: run the multi-LoRA offline inference example with Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct and a SQL text-to-SQL LoRA adapter
initialize_llm_engine_with_lora: initialize a vLLM LLMEngine with multi-LoRA support enabling max_loras, max_lora_rank, and max_cpu_loras settings
create_test_prompts_with_lora_requests: create a list of test prompts paired with sampling parameters and optional LoRARequest objects for offline inference
process_requests_with_lora_engine: process a list of prompts through an LLMEngine step by step, adding requests with LoRA adapters and printing finished outputs
review_multilora_offline_example: review the multi-LoRA offline inference example that demonstrates batching base model and LoRA adapter requests
